source_commit_policy: Resolve every source fact from the release candidate commit; never derive a threshold from the N6 run it judges.

provisioning_requirements.cpu_model: record the actual model for every provisioned host

observed_nonqualifying_host.network_link: 100 Mbps symmetric (In 100.0 Mbps / Out 100.0 Mbps), MAC fa:16:3e:7c:0e:03, /23 subnet

available_paths: provision 21 bare-metal hosts meeting this specification
change required_scales explicitly with written and machine-enforced extrapolation
virtual machines cannot produce release evidence because their host frequency policy is unobservable
release_hardware_profile.rationale: The machine-enforced required scale and section 0.5 require 21 real hosts. Each host needs at least 16 GiB because the 390.48 MiB pending-finality budget is only one component of node RSS and 12 GiB was already marginal; at least 1 Gbps because a 984260-byte maximum carrier consumes 78.7 ms at 100 Mbps before fan-out and 157.5 ms after accepted network headroom; NVMe SSD for state-database write amplification; and at least 8 physical cores. Release timing is attributable only with governor performance and boost/turbo disabled, because throttling changes latency and tail variance while boost makes peak frequency depend on thermals. A virtual guest cannot truthfully report host governor or boost state, so it cannot satisfy this profile. The actual CPU model is recorded only after the 21 hosts exist; the live criteria sentinel remains until then.

rationale.timing_windows: Normal operation must complete within half of the finality, block-signature, and lite-query timeout envelopes; the remaining half is recovery margin rather than operating budget. The same finality-window fraction makes loss of finalized-height progress visible halfway to the standstill timeout.
rationale.authority_slot: Authority classification may consume at most one fifth of a ConfigParam30 target block slot, leaving the rest of that slot for consensus work.
rationale.resources: CPU, RSS, network, and disk headroom implement section 4.3's refusal to accept a release profile that operates a processor, memory budget, link, or storage device at its limit.
rationale.finalization_backpressure: Only ten percent of observations may be backpressured because backpressure occurring at all is already close to the progress failure it is meant to prevent.

schema_version.rationale: The proposal targets the currently enforced N6 acceptance-criteria schema and must be reviewed again if that schema changes.

release_hardware_profile.rationale: Hardware-dependent latency and resource fractions are meaningful only on the reviewed CPU, memory, storage and link profile, including the CPU governor and whether turbo or boost is enabled. A throttling governor invalidates a release timing claim because it changes both sustained frequency and tail variance.

required_scales.rationale: The sole release scale is the enforced 21-validator launch ceiling, not an owner preference. ConfigParam16 and ConfigParam28 reject larger configured limits in crypto/smartcont/config-code.fc; node configuration admission rejects them through Config::validate_pq_launch_resource_config in crypto/block/mc-config.cpp and validator/manager.cpp; and both production Genesis in crypto/smartcont/gen-zerostate.fif and tostester Genesis in test/tostester/src/tostester/zerostate.py construct and enforce the same cap. Requiring unreachable 32/64/100 committees after those four enforcement points would not test a production configuration. Inherited-consensus evidence is prior context only: git tree 628506c9e already contains 16 validator/consensus/simplex files, and the reviewed upstream deployment operates that stack at approximately 400 validators. It does not close O-2 measurement gaps; release evidence still requires measurements on 21 independent hosts.

required_network_profiles.rationale: Compute isolation, the reviewed deployment link, and recovery under worse-than-launch conditions are separate claims.

required_workloads.rationale: Consensus cost must pass alone and with reviewed fractions of the authoritative gas, byte and collated-data limits.

max_p99_persisted_finality_ms.rationale: The normal persisted-finality SLO must finish, including persistence, before ConfigParam30's first leader window (first-block timeout plus four target-rate slots); the owner-selected reserve is recovery headroom.

max_p99_block_signature_verify_ms.rationale: The production signature/context path has a two-second deadline that also covers proof and state work, so signature verification must leave an explicit fraction of it unused.

max_p99_lite_verify_ms.rationale: The production lite query deadline is ten seconds and includes transport and proof-chain work; the verification threshold reserves the owner-reviewed remainder for those costs.

max_cpu_fraction.rationale: CPU occupancy is capped below the reviewed hardware profile so proof/restart recovery is not attempted at saturation.

max_rss_fraction.rationale: RSS includes the 409452160-byte hostile-input finality cap and must retain reviewed memory for the database, actors and recovery.

max_network_fraction.rationale: Network occupancy is relative to the reviewed hardware profile's link capacity and reserves bandwidth for retransmission, catch-up and finality recovery.

max_disk_busy_fraction.rationale: Disk occupancy is relative to the reviewed storage profile and leaves capacity for proof persistence, archive reconstruction and restart recovery.

max_finalization_backpressure_fraction.rationale: The permitted backpressured fraction must leave an owner-reviewed progress margin rather than accepting a run that spends nearly all of its time throttled.

max_pending_finality_bytes.rationale: This is the enforced sum of the 16-carrier public pool and 400-carrier validator-reserved pool at 984260 bytes each; the RSS criterion supplies system headroom above this hostile-input ceiling.

max_pending_finality_candidates.rationale: This is the conservative structural count floor(15748160/4096) + floor(393704000/4096) from the two disjoint byte pools and minimum per-entry charge.

max_authority_classification_p99_ms.rationale: Admission classification precedes retained work and must fit inside one ConfigParam30 target-rate slot while reserving time for all remaining consensus work.

max_unbounded_memory_slope_bytes_per_hou.rationale: No positive long-run memory slope is safe; bounded caches may fill and drain but cannot grow with run duration.

max_finalized_height_stall_ms.rationale: ConfigParam30 declares standstill after ten seconds; the acceptance threshold must detect loss of progress before that recovery trigger, with owner-selected headroom.

safety_violations_allowed.rationale: No timing, hardware or network profile makes a consensus safety violation acceptable.

process_crashes_allowed.rationale: The release run must survive the committed load and recovery schedule without a process crash.

invalid_proofs_accepted.rationale: Proof validity is an authority property, not a performance trade-off.
